verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ יֹאשִׁיָּ֧הוּ בִֽירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם פֶּ֖סַח לַיהוָ֑ה וַיִּשְׁחֲט֣וּ הַפֶּ֔סַח בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś yō·šî·yā·hū ḇî·rū·šā·lim pe·saḥ Yah·weh way·yiš·ḥă·ṭū hap·pe·saḥ bə·’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn
verses.literal: Then Josiah kept the Passover to the LORD in Jerusalem and the Passover lamb was slaughtered on the fourteenth . . . day of the first month
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO Josias celebrou a páscoa ao SENHOR em Jerusalém; e mataram o cordeiro da páscoa no décimo quarto dia do primeiro mês.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֵ֥ד הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים עַל־ מִשְׁמְרוֹתָ֑ם וַֽיְחַזְּקֵ֔ם לַעֲבוֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mêḏ hak·kō·hă·nîm ‘al- miš·mə·rō·w·ṯām way·ḥaz·zə·qêm la·‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏaṯ bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: He appointed the priests to their duties and encouraged them in the service of the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: E estabeleceu os sacerdotes nos seus cargos, e os animou ao ministério da casa do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לַ֠לְוִיִּם הַמְּבוּנִים לְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הַקְּדוֹשִׁ֣ים לַיהוָ֗ה תְּנ֤וּ אֶת־ אֲרוֹן־ הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ בַּ֠בַּיִת אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנָ֜ה שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה בֶן־ דָּוִיד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵין־ לָכֶ֥ם מַשָּׂ֖א בַּכָּתֵ֑ף עַתָּ֗ה עִבְדוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת עַמּ֥וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lal·wî·yim ham·mə·ḇū·nīm lə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl haq·qə·ḏō·wō·šîm Yah·weh tə·nū ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn- haq·qō·ḏeš bab·ba·yiṯ ’ă·šer bā·nāh šə·lō·mōh ḇen- dā·wîḏ me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl ’ên- lā·ḵem maś·śā bak·kā·ṯêp̄ ‘at·tāh ‘iḇ·ḏū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·’êṯ ‘am·mōw yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: To the Levites who taught all Israel and were holy to the LORD Josiah said Put the holy ark in the temple built by Solomon son of David king of Israel It is not to be carried around on your shoulders Now serve the LORD your God and His people Israel
verses.literalPt: E disse aos levitas que ensinavam a todo o Israel e estavam consagrados ao SENHOR: Ponde a arca sagrada na casa que edificou Salomão, filho de Davi, rei de Israel; não tereis mais esta carga aos ombros; agora servi ao SENHOR vosso Deus, e ao seu povo Israel.

verses.original: וְהָכִ֥ונוּ לְבֵית־ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם כְּמַחְלְקוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם בִּכְתָ֗ב דָּוִיד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּבְמִכְתַּ֖ב שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hå̄·ḵi·w·nū lə·ḇêṯ- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem kə·maḥ·lə·qō·w·ṯê·ḵem biḵ·ṯāḇ dā·wîḏ me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇə·miḵ·taḇ šə·lō·mōh ḇə·nōw
verses.literal: Prepare yourselves by families . . . in your divisions according to the instructions written by David king of Israel and Solomon his son
verses.literalPt: E preparai-vos segundo as vossas casas paternas e segundo as vossas turmas, conforme à prescrição de Davi, rei de Israel, e a de Salomão, seu filho.

verses.original: וְעִמְד֣וּ בַקֹּ֗דֶשׁ לִפְלֻגּוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הָֽאָב֔וֹת לַאֲחֵיכֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וַחֲלֻקַּ֥ת בֵּֽית־ אָ֖ב לַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘im·ḏū ḇaq·qō·ḏeš lip̄·lug·gō·wṯ bêṯ hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ la·’ă·ḥê·ḵem bə·nê hā·‘ām wa·ḥă·luq·qaṯ bêṯ- ’āḇ lal·wî·yim
verses.literal: Moreover, stand in the Holy Place by the divisions of the families . . . of your kinsmen the lay people . . . and by the divisions of the families . . . of the Levites
verses.literalPt: E estai no santuário segundo as divisões das casas paternas de vossos irmãos, os filhos do povo; e haja para cada divisão uma parte de uma família de levitas.

verses.original: וְשַׁחֲט֖וּ הַפָּ֑סַח וְהִתְקַדְּשׁוּ֙ וְהָכִ֣ינוּ לַאֲחֵיכֶ֔ם לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת כִּדְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ša·ḥă·ṭū hap·pā·saḥ wə·hiṯ·qad·də·šū wə·hā·ḵî·nū la·’ă·ḥê·ḵem la·‘ă·śō·wṯ kiḏ·ḇar- Yah·weh bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: Slaughter the Passover lambs consecrate yourselves and make preparations for your fellow countrymen to carry out the word of the LORD given by Moses
verses.literalPt: E imolai a páscoa, e santificai-vos, e preparai-a para vossos irmãos, fazendo conforme a palavra do SENHOR, dada pela mão de Moisés.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣רֶם יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ לִבְנֵ֪י הָעָ֟ם צֹ֞אן כְּבָשִׂ֣ים וּבְנֵֽי־ עִזִּים֮ הַכֹּ֣ל לַפְּסָחִים֒ לְכָל־ הַנִּמְצָ֗א לְמִסְפַּר֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וּבָקָ֖ר שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים אֵ֖לֶּה מֵרְכ֥וּשׁ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·rem yō·šî·yā·hū liḇ·nê hā·‘ām ṣōn kə·ḇā·śîm ū·ḇə·nê- ‘iz·zîm hak·kōl lap·pə·sā·ḥîm lə·ḵāl han·nim·ṣā lə·mis·par šə·lō·šîm ’e·lep̄ ū·ḇā·qār šə·lō·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ’êl·leh mê·rə·ḵūš ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: From his own flocks and herds Josiah contributed 30,000 . . . lambs and goats plus 3,000 . . . . . . bulls for the Passover offerings for all the people who were present . . .
verses.literalPt: E ofereceu Josias, aos filhos do povo, cordeiros e cabritos do rebanho, todos para os sacrifícios da páscoa, em número de trinta mil, por todos os que ali se achavam, e de bois três mil; isto era da fazenda do rei.

verses.original: וְשָׂרָ֞יו לִנְדָבָ֥ה לָעָ֛ם לַכֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֖ם הֵרִ֑ימוּ חִלְקִיָּ֨ה וּזְכַרְיָ֜הוּ וִֽיחִיאֵ֗ל נְגִידֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים לַכֹּהֲנִ֞ים נָתְנ֣וּ לַפְּסָחִ֗ים אַלְפַּ֙יִם֙ וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת וּבָקָ֖ר שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śā·rāw lin·ḏā·ḇāh lā·‘ām lak·kō·hă·nîm wə·lal·wî·yim hê·rî·mū ḥil·qî·yāh ū·zə·ḵar·yā·hū wî·ḥî·’êl nə·ḡî·ḏê bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lak·kō·hă·nîm nā·ṯə·nū lap·pə·sā·ḥîm ’al·pa·yim wə·šêš mê·’ō·wṯ ū·ḇā·qār šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: His officials also contributed willingly to the people and priests and Levites Hilkiah Zechariah and Jehiel the chief officials of the house of God gave the priests 2,600 . . . . . . Passover offerings and 300 . . . bulls
verses.literalPt: Também apresentaram os seus príncipes ofertas voluntárias ao povo, aos sacerdotes e aos levitas: Hilquias, e Zacarias, e Jeiel, líderes da casa de Deus, deram aos sacerdotes para os sacrifícios da páscoa duas mil e seiscentas reses de gado miúdo, e trezentos bois.

verses.original: וְכָונַנְיָהוּ וּשְׁמַֽעְיָ֨הוּ וּנְתַנְאֵ֜ל אֶחָ֗יו וַחֲשַׁבְיָ֧הוּ וִיעִיאֵ֛ל וְיוֹזָבָ֖ד שָׂרֵ֣י הַלְוִיִּ֑ם הֵרִ֨ימוּ לַלְוִיִּ֤ם לַפְּסָחִים֙ חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּבָקָ֖ר חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵå̄·w·nan·yå̄·hū ū·šə·ma‘·yā·hū ū·nə·ṯan·’êl ’e·ḥāw wa·ḥă·šaḇ·yā·hū wî·‘î·’êl wə·yō·w·zā·ḇāḏ śā·rê hal·wî·yim hê·rî·mū lal·wî·yim lap·pə·sā·ḥîm ḥă·mê·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ū·ḇā·qār ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Additionally, Conaniah and his brothers Shemaiah and Nethanel as well as Hashabiah Jeiel and Jozabad officers of the Levites contributed to the Levites 5,000 . . . Passover offerings and 500 . . . bulls
verses.literalPt: E Conanias, e Semaías, e Natanael, seus irmãos, como também Hasabias, e Jeiel, e Jozabade, chefe dos levitas, apresentaram aos levitas, para os sacrifícios da páscoa, cinco mil reses de gado miúdo, e quinhentos bois.

verses.original: וַתִּכּ֖וֹן הָעֲבוֹדָ֑ה וַיַּֽעַמְד֨וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים עַל־ עָמְדָ֛ם וְהַלְוִיִּ֥ם עַל־ מַחְלְקוֹתָ֖ם כְּמִצְוַ֥ת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tik·kō·wn hā·‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏāh way·ya·‘am·ḏū hak·kō·hă·nîm ‘al- ‘ā·mə·ḏām wə·hal·wî·yim ‘al- maḥ·lə·qō·w·ṯām kə·miṣ·waṯ ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: So the service was prepared the priests stood in their places and the Levites in their divisions according to the king’s command
verses.literalPt: Assim se preparou o serviço, e puseram-se os sacerdotes nos seus postos, e os levitas nas suas turmas, conforme a ordem do rei,

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁחֲט֖וּ הַפָּ֑סַח וַיִּזְרְק֤וּ הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ מִיָּדָ֔ם וְהַלְוִיִּ֖ם מַפְשִׁיטִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ḥă·ṭū hap·pā·saḥ way·yiz·rə·qū hak·kō·hă·nîm mî·yā·ḏām wə·hal·wî·yim map̄·šî·ṭîm
verses.literal: And they slaughtered the Passover lambs while the priests splattered the blood handed to them and the Levites skinned the animals
verses.literalPt: Então imolaram a páscoa; e os sacerdotes espargiram o sangue recebido das mãos dos levitas que esfolavam as reses.

verses.original: וַיָּסִ֨ירוּ הָעֹלָ֜ה לְ֠תִתָּם לְמִפְלַגּ֤וֹת לְבֵית־ אָבוֹת֙ לִבְנֵ֣י הָעָ֔ם לְהַקְרִיב֙ לַיהוָ֔ה כַּכָּת֖וּב בְּסֵ֣פֶר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְכֵ֖ן לַבָּקָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·sî·rū hā·‘ō·lāh lə·ṯit·tām lə·mip̄·lag·gō·wṯ lə·ḇêṯ- ’ā·ḇō·wṯ liḇ·nê hā·‘ām lə·haq·rîḇ Yah·weh kak·kā·ṯūḇ bə·sê·p̄er mō·šeh wə·ḵên lab·bā·qār
verses.literal: They set aside the burnt offerings to be given to the divisions of the families . . . of the people to offer to the LORD as it is written in the Book of Moses And they did the same with the bulls
verses.literalPt: E puseram de parte os holocaustos para os darem aos filhos do povo, segundo as divisões das casas paternas, para o oferecerem ao SENHOR, como está escrito no livro de Moisés; e assim fizeram com os bois.

verses.original: וַֽיְבַשְּׁל֥וּ הַפֶּ֛סַח בָּאֵ֖שׁ כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְהַקֳּדָשִׁ֣ים בִּשְּׁל֗וּ בַּסִּיר֤וֹת וּבַדְּוָדִים֙ וּבַצֵּ֣לָח֔וֹת וַיָּרִ֖יצוּ לְכָל־ בְּנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇaš·šə·lū hap·pe·saḥ bā·’êš kam·miš·pāṭ wə·haq·qo·ḏā·šîm biš·šə·lū bas·sî·rō·wṯ ū·ḇad·də·wā·ḏîm ū·ḇaṣ·ṣê·lā·ḥō·wṯ way·yā·rî·ṣū lə·ḵāl bə·nê hā·‘ām
verses.literal: They roasted the Passover animals on the fire according to the regulation and they boiled the other holy offerings in pots kettles and bowls and quickly brought them to all the people
verses.literalPt: E assaram a páscoa no fogo, segundo o rito; e as ofertas sagradas cozeram em panelas, e em caldeirões e em sertãs; e prontamente as repartiram entre todo o povo.

verses.original: וְאַחַ֗ר הֵכִ֤ינוּ לָהֶם֙ וְלַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים כִּ֤י הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן בְּהַֽעֲל֛וֹת הָעוֹלָ֥ה וְהַחֲלָבִ֖ים עַד־ לָ֑יְלָה וְהַלְוִיִּם֙ הֵכִ֣ינוּ לָהֶ֔ם וְלַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥar hê·ḵî·nū lā·hem wə·lak·kō·hă·nîm kî hak·kō·hă·nîm bə·nê ’a·hă·rōn bə·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ hā·‘ō·w·lāh wə·ha·ḥă·lā·ḇîm ‘aḏ- lā·yə·lāh wə·hal·wî·yim hê·ḵî·nū lā·hem wə·lak·kō·hă·nîm bə·nê ’a·hă·rōn
verses.literal: Afterward they made preparations for themselves and for the priests since the priests the descendants of Aaron were offering up burnt offerings and fat until nightfall So the Levites made preparations for themselves and for the priests the descendants of Aaron
verses.literalPt: Depois prepararam para si e para os sacerdotes; porque os sacerdotes, filhos de Arão, se ocuparam até à noite com o sacrifício dos holocaustos e da gordura; por isso os levitas prepararam para si e para os sacerdotes, filhos de Arão.

verses.original: וְהַמְשֹֽׁרֲרִ֨ים בְּנֵי־ אָסָ֜ף עַל־ מַעֲמָדָ֗ם כְּמִצְוַ֤ת דָּוִיד֙ וְאָסָ֞ף וְהֵימָ֤ן וִֽידֻתוּן֙ חוֹזֵ֣ה הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִ֖ים לְשַׁ֣עַר וָשָׁ֑עַר אֵ֣ין לָהֶ֗ם לָסוּר֙ מֵעַ֣ל עֲבֹֽדָתָ֔ם כִּֽי־ אֲחֵיהֶ֥ם הַלְוִיִּ֖ם הֵכִ֥ינוּ לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·šō·ră·rîm bə·nê- ’ā·sāp̄ ‘al- ma·‘ă·mā·ḏām kə·miṣ·waṯ dā·wîḏ wə·’ā·sāp̄ wə·hê·mān wî·ḏu·ṯūn ḥō·w·zêh ham·me·leḵ wə·haš·šō·‘ă·rîm lə·ša·‘ar wå̄·šå̄·ʿar ’ên lā·hem lā·sūr mê·‘al ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯām kî- ’ă·ḥê·hem hal·wî·yim hê·ḵî·nū lā·hem
verses.literal: The singers the descendants of Asaph were at their stations according to the command of David Asaph Heman and Jeduthun the king’s seer And the gatekeepers at each gate . . . did not need to leave . . . their posts because their fellow Levites made preparations for them
verses.literalPt: E os cantores, filhos de Asafe, estavam no seu posto, segundo o mandado de Davi, e de Asafe, e de Hemã, e de Jedutum, vidente do rei, como também os porteiros a cada porta; não necessitaram de se desviarem do seu ministério; porquanto seus irmãos, os levitas, preparavam o necessário para eles.

verses.original: וַ֠תִּכּוֹן כָּל־ עֲבוֹדַ֨ת יְהוָ֜ה בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת הַפֶּ֔סַח וְהַעֲל֣וֹת עֹל֔וֹת עַ֖ל מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֑ה כְּמִצְוַ֖ת הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tik·kō·wn kāl- ‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏaṯ Yah·weh bay·yō·wm ha·hū la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hap·pe·saḥ wə·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ ‘ō·lō·wṯ ‘al miz·baḥ Yah·weh kə·miṣ·waṯ ham·me·leḵ yō·šî·yā·hū
verses.literal: So on that day the entire service of the LORD was carried out for celebrating the Passover and offering burnt offerings on the altar of the LORD according to the command of King Josiah
verses.literalPt: Assim se estabeleceu todo o serviço do SENHOR naquele dia, para celebrar a páscoa, e oferecer holocaustos sobre o altar do SENHOR, segundo a ordem do rei Josias.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֨וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל הַֽנִּמְצְאִ֛ים אֶת־ הַפֶּ֖סַח בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑יא וְאֶת־ חַ֥ג הַמַּצּ֖וֹת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl han·nim·ṣə·’îm ’eṯ- hap·pe·saḥ bā·‘êṯ ha·hî wə·’eṯ- ḥaḡ ham·maṣ·ṣō·wṯ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . who were present also observed the Passover at that time as well as the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Israel que ali se acharam celebraram a páscoa naquele tempo, e a festa dos pães ázimos, durante sete dias.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ נַעֲשָׂ֨ה פֶ֤סַח כָּמֹ֙הוּ֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִימֵ֖י שְׁמוּאֵ֣ל הַנָּבִ֑יא וְכָל־ מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל׀ לֹֽא־ עָשׂ֡וּ כַּפֶּ֣סַח אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֣ה יֹֽ֠אשִׁיָּהוּ וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֤ם וְכָל־ יְהוּדָה֙ וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הַנִּמְצָ֔א וְיוֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- na·‘ă·śāh p̄e·saḥ kā·mō·hū bə·yiś·rā·’êl mî·mê šə·mū·’êl han·nā·ḇî wə·ḵāl mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl lō- ‘ā·śū kap·pe·saḥ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh yō·šî·yā·hū wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hal·wî·yim wə·ḵāl yə·hū·ḏāh wə·yiś·rā·’êl han·nim·ṣā wə·yō·wō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: No such Passover had been observed in Israel since the days of Samuel the prophet None . . . of the kings of Israel ever observed a Passover like the one that Josiah observed with the priests the Levites all Judah the Israelites who were present and the people of Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Nunca, pois, se celebrou tal páscoa em Israel, desde os dias do profeta Samuel; nem nenhum rei de Israel celebrou tal páscoa como a que celebrou Josias com os sacerdotes, e levitas, e todo o Judá e Israel, que ali se acharam, e os habitantes de Jerusalém.

verses.original: בִּשְׁמוֹנֶ֤ה עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְמַלְכ֖וּת יֹאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ נַעֲשָׂ֖ה הַפֶּ֥סַח הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: biš·mō·w·neh ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh lə·mal·ḵūṯ yō·šî·yā·hū na·‘ă·śāh hap·pe·saḥ haz·zeh
verses.literal: In the eighteenth . . . year of Josiah’s reign this Passover was observed
verses.literalPt: No décimo oitavo ano do reinado de Josias se celebrou esta páscoa.

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֣י כָל־ זֹ֗את אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵכִ֤ין יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֙הוּ֙ אֶת־ הַבַּ֔יִת עָלָ֞ה נְכ֧וֹ מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֛יִם לְהִלָּחֵ֥ם בְּכַרְכְּמִ֖ישׁ עַל־ פְּרָ֑ת וַיֵּצֵ֥א לִקְרָאת֖וֹ יֹאשִׁיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rê ḵāl zōṯ ’ă·šer hê·ḵîn yō·šî·yā·hū ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ ‘ā·lāh nə·ḵōw me·leḵ- miṣ·ra·yim lə·hil·lā·ḥêm bə·ḵar·kə·mîš ‘al- pə·rāṯ way·yê·ṣê liq·rā·ṯōw yō·šî·yā·hū
verses.literal: After all this when Josiah had set the temple in order Neco king of Egypt marched up to fight at Carchemish by the Euphrates and Josiah went out to confront him
verses.literalPt: Depois de tudo isto, havendo Josias já preparado o templo, subiu Neco, rei do Egito, para guerrear contra Carquemis, junto ao Eufrates; e Josias lhe saiu ao encontro.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח אֵלָ֣יו מַלְאָכִ֣ים׀ לֵאמֹר֩׀ מַה־ לִּ֨י וָלָ֜ךְ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה לֹא־ עָלֶ֨יךָ אַתָּ֤ה הַיּוֹם֙ כִּ֚י אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית מִלְחַמְתִּ֔י וֵאלֹהִ֖ים אָמַ֣ר לְבַֽהֲלֵ֑נִי חֲדַל־ לְךָ֛ מֵאֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־ עִמִּ֖י וְאַל־ יַשְׁחִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ’ê·lāw mal·’ā·ḵîm lê·mōr mah- lî wā·lāḵ me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh lō- ‘ā·le·ḵā ’at·tāh hay·yō·wm kî ’el- bêṯ mil·ḥam·tî wê·lō·hîm ’ā·mar lə·ḇa·hă·lê·nî ḥă·ḏal- lə·ḵā mê·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer- ‘im·mî wə·’al- yaš·ḥî·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: But Neco sent messengers to him saying What is the issue between you and me . . . . . . O king of Judah I have not come against you today but . . . I am fighting another dynasty and God has told me to hurry So stop opposing God who is with me or He will destroy you
verses.literalPt: Então ele lhe mandou mensageiros, dizendo: Que tenho eu contigo, rei de Judá? Não é contra ti que venho hoje, mas contra a casa que me faz guerra; e disse Deus que me apressasse; guarda-te de te opores a Deus, que é comigo, para que ele não te destrua.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ הֵסֵב֩ יֹאשִׁיָּ֨הוּ פָנָ֜יו מִמֶּ֗נּוּ כִּ֤י לְהִלָּחֵֽם־ בּוֹ֙ הִתְחַפֵּ֔שׂ וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֛ע אֶל־ דִּבְרֵ֥י נְכ֖וֹ מִפִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיָּבֹ֕א לְהִלָּחֵ֖ם בְּבִקְעַ֥ת מְגִדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- hê·sêḇ yō·šî·yā·hū p̄ā·nāw mim·men·nū kî lə·hil·lā·ḥêm- bōw hiṯ·ḥap·pêś wə·lō šā·ma‘ ’el- diḇ·rê nə·ḵōw mip·pî ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yā·ḇō lə·hil·lā·ḥêm bə·ḇiq·‘aṯ mə·ḡid·dōw
verses.literal: Josiah, however . . . did not turn away from him instead in order to engage him in battle he disguised himself He did not listen to Neco’s words from the mouth of God but went to fight him on the Plain of Megiddo
verses.literalPt: Porém Josias não virou dele o seu rosto, antes se disfarçou, para pelejar contra ele; e não deu ouvidos às palavras de Neco, que saíram da boca de Deus; antes veio pelejar no vale de Megido.

verses.original: וַיֹּרוּ֙ הַיֹּרִ֔ים לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ לַעֲבָדָיו֙ הַעֲבִיר֔וּנִי כִּ֥י הָחֳלֵ֖יתִי מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·rū hay·yō·rîm lam·me·leḵ yō·šî·yā·hū way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ha·‘ă·ḇî·rū·nî kî hā·ḥo·lê·ṯî mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: There the archers shot King Josiah who said to his servants Take me away for I am badly wounded
verses.literalPt: E os flecheiros atiraram contra o rei Josias. Então o rei disse a seus servos: Tirai-me daqui, porque estou gravemente ferido.

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲבִירֻ֨הוּ עֲבָדָ֜יו מִן־ הַמֶּרְכָּבָ֗ה וַֽיַּרְכִּיבֻהוּ֮ עַ֣ל רֶ֣כֶב הַמִּשְׁנֶה֮ אֲשֶׁר־ לוֹ֒ וַיּוֹלִיכֻ֙הוּ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַיָּ֕מָת וַיִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּקִבְר֣וֹת אֲבֹתָ֑יו וְכָל־ יְהוּדָה֙ וִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם מִֽתְאַבְּלִ֖ים עַל־ יֹאשִׁיָּֽהוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·ḇî·ru·hū ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw min- ham·mer·kā·ḇāh way·yar·kî·ḇu·hū ‘al re·ḵeḇ ham·miš·neh ’ă·šer- lōw way·yō·w·lî·ḵu·hū yə·rū·šā·lim way·yā·māṯ way·yiq·qā·ḇêr bə·qiḇ·rō·wṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw wə·ḵāl yə·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim miṯ·’ab·bə·lîm ‘al- yō·šî·yā·hū
verses.literal: So his servants took him out of his chariot put him in his second chariot and brought him to Jerusalem where he died And Josiah was buried in the tomb of his fathers and all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for him
verses.literalPt: E seus servos o tiraram do carro, e o levaram no segundo carro que tinha, e o trouxeram a Jerusalém; e morreu, e o sepultaram nos sepulcros de seus pais; e todo o Judá e Jerusalém prantearam a Josias.

verses.original: וַיְקוֹנֵ֣ן יִרְמְיָהוּ֮ עַל־ יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ֒ וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ כָֽל־ הַשָּׁרִ֣ים׀ וְ֠הַשָּׁרוֹת בְּקִינ֨וֹתֵיהֶ֤ם עַל־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֙הוּ֙ עַד־ הַיּ֔וֹם וַיִּתְּנ֥וּם לְחֹ֖ק עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהִנָּ֥ם כְּתוּבִ֖ים עַל־ הַקִּינֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·qō·w·nên yir·mə·yā·hū ‘al- yō·šî·yā·hū way·yō·mə·rū ḵāl haš·šā·rîm wə·haš·šā·rō·wṯ bə·qî·nō·w·ṯê·hem ‘al- yō·šî·yā·hū ‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm way·yit·tə·nūm lə·ḥōq ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl wə·hin·nām kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- haq·qî·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then Jeremiah lamented over Josiah and to this day all the male and female singers recite laments over Josiah They established them as a statute for Israel and indeed they are written in the Book of Laments
verses.literalPt: E Jeremias fez uma lamentação sobre Josias; e todos os cantores e cantoras, nas suas lamentações, têm falado de Josias, até ao dia de hoje; porque as estabeleceram por estatuto em Israel; e eis que estão escritas nas lamentações.

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ וַחֲסָדָ֑יו כַּכָּת֖וּב בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê yō·šî·yā·hū wa·ḥă·sā·ḏāw kak·kā·ṯūḇ bə·ṯō·w·raṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Josiah and his deeds of loving devotion according to what is written in the Law of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Quanto ao mais dos atos de Josias, e as suas boas obras, conforme o que está escrito na lei do SENHOR,

verses.original: וּדְבָרָ֕יו הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְהָאַחֲרֹנִ֑ים הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל־ סֵ֥פֶר מַלְכֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִיהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḏə·ḇā·rāw hā·ri·šō·nîm wə·hā·’a·ḥă·rō·nîm hin·nām kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er mal·ḵê- yiś·rā·’êl wî·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: his acts from beginning to end they are indeed written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah
verses.literalPt: E os seus atos, tanto os primeiros como os últimos, eis que estão escritos no livro dos reis de Israel e de Judá.
